project_title: Signup Bonus Protection System - Design Guidelines
design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + PERFORMANCE DATA DENSITY
theme: Dark Command Center / High-Contrast Fraud Control

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

visual_enhancers.card_style: Flat slate surfaces with 1px subtle borders (border-slate-800/80), dark glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80)
visual_enhancers.badges: High-contrast status tags with subtle glowing borders and crisp uppercase text
visual_enhancers.data_density: MODE B High Density Grid for security monitoring, tabular drilldown drawers, clear metrics callout
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle dark slate grid lines, status dots with soft pulse animation

components.bonus_settings_panel: Card container with clean switches, numerical input fields for bonus limits and purchase thresholds, data-testid attributes on all controls
components.fraud_protection_rules: Interactive check toggle grid (Device Fingerprint, IP Subnet, Verified Email/Phone, Multi-Account Detection)
components.bonus_history_table: Data-dense Shadcn Table with sorting, status badges, user metadata tooltip, filter tabs
components.suspicious_user_list: Dedicated security triage panel with quick review actions (Approve Bonus, Reject & Ban, Hold for Review)
components.json_drawer: Slide-over sheet with JetBrains Mono preview for fraud triggers & device fingerprint comparison

grids_and_layouts.layout_mode: MODE B: High Density Admin Grid
grids_and_layouts.header_spacing: pt-6 pb-4 px-4 sm:px-8 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-40

motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Smooth transition-colors duration-200, hover lift (-translate-y-0.5) on action buttons
motion_and_interactions.status_pulse: Soft relative ping indicator for active suspicious flags
motion_and_interactions.rule_transitions: AnimatePresence for expand/collapse of fraud rule config panels

accessibility.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA compliant contrast ratio (minimum 4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large headers)
accessibility.testing_attribute: CRITICAL: All interactive elements, inputs, action buttons, status pills, and tables MUST contain data-testid attributes using kebab-case role naming.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep existing buyer/seller/admin views, authentication, wallet, and payment systems intact.
2. Add the Bonus Protection System as a modular tab or section in the existing Admin dashboard.
3. Ensure all backend endpoints (/api/admin/bonus-settings, /api/admin/bonus-history, /api/admin/suspicious-users, /api/admin/verify-bonus-action) match exact required parameters.
4. Ensure every button, input, toggle, tab, table row, and badge includes a descriptive data-testid attribute.
5. Use dark mode palette specified in guidelines with zero pure black (#000000) backgrounds; prefer deep slate (#090d16 and #111827).
6. Front-end code files are React .js files.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not change wallet, payment, order, database structure, or existing features.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
Use sonner for notifications and toasts.
Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML dropdowns/inputs.
